evaluation_basis: Direct visual comparison of the supplied 1536x864 target, round 04 and round 03 images, followed by enlarged inspection of the train front, train recession, opposing facade, roof and terminal, paving and track, right wall and props, and sign. A labeled full-frame comparison was also inspected. PIL crops and resizes are inspection artifacts, NOT new engine renders, and were written only to the session workspace. Positions below are approximate original-image coordinates. Only visible pixels receive credit; claimed implementation changes, authorized texture provenance and asset counts do not establish a match. Performance was not assessed.

coverage.note: Every component has an assessable visible portion. Occlusion does not excuse missing target-visible features. Hidden coal, concealed axles and other unseen construction are not inferred.

component_audit.target_observation: Two complete dark round buffer heads sit near (65,580) and (335,584), with projecting red shafts and circular mounting plates; the left silhouette clears the frame.
component_audit.actual_observation: The heads sit roughly 35-40 pixels higher. The left head is clipped at the image boundary; the short dark projections and mounting transitions are much less articulated.
component_audit.correction: Fit both complete head silhouettes, their centers and shaft lengths together; lower the assembly to the target beam height and restore the red collars and circular bolted plates.

component_audit.target_observation: A weathered scarlet beam spans approximately x80-450, y514-614, with varied bolts, substantial end thickness and dark connected hardware.
component_audit.actual_observation: A clean rectangular red plate spans approximately x25-422, y494-583. Its pale right highlight, evenly repeated bolts and simplified end connections differ from the target.
component_audit.correction: Correct its screen bounds and height, reduce the smooth pale highlight, and reproduce the uneven fasteners, bracket attachments, chipped paint and substantial end construction.

component_audit.target_observation: The center beneath the beam contains a compact hook and attachment mass, curved hoses, chain-like connections and vertical machinery extending toward the rails.
component_audit.actual_observation: Several repeated long diagonal rods or hoses hang separately across the beam, with conspicuous spring-like lower sections. They do not read as the target's central connected coupling.
component_audit.correction: Replace the repeated hanging silhouettes with the specific central hook, attachments, curved hose routes and connected lower assembly visible in the target.

component_audit.target_observation: A raised, riveted front apron occupies approximately x140-490, y440-519, with sloping side transitions into narrow running boards and substantial machinery beneath.
component_audit.actual_observation: A broad shallow black shelf and wedge-like surface sit above the red beam. The side board is a straight red strip; the apron lacks the target's upright shaped face and connected mass.
component_audit.correction: Rebuild the target silhouette as an upright shaped apron with angled returns, then connect it to the footplate, cylinder area and side running boards rather than another horizontal shelf.

component_audit.target_observation: The near-circular door around (325,300) is subtly convex, set into a substantial housing, and predominantly dark blackened steel with restrained grazing wear.
component_audit.actual_observation: The door is in the broadly correct region and has a readable perimeter, but a broad silver-white patch and bright rim dominate its right half. Its surface reads comparatively flat and mottled.
component_audit.correction: Retain the useful approximate placement while matching the convex shading, housing depth and dark steel response; confine bright wear to small edges and local reflections.

component_audit.target_observation: Two horizontal straps, right-side hinges, a long central latch, an oval lower number plate and a small detailed brass lantern organize the door face.
component_audit.actual_observation: Rim rivets, short fittings and a small central cross are visible, but the lower oval plate is not legible and the top lamp is a bright round disk on a simple block.
component_audit.correction: Match the strap lengths and hinge positions, restore the longer latch and lower oval plate, and replace the disk-like lamp with the target lantern's housing and restrained light.

component_audit.target_observation: The stack has a broad flared lip near y105, a dark slightly tapered barrel and a substantial transition into the smokebox.
component_audit.actual_observation: Its top is near y82, too high, with a comparatively narrow rim and a strong vertical silver reflection. The stack reads as a simple glossy tube.
component_audit.correction: Lower the lip to the target landmark, reproduce its flare and base transition, and darken the barrel while preserving small worn rim highlights.

component_audit.target_observation: Large dark red cylinder housings and connected angled pipes fill the area below and behind the apron, especially around x470-560, y465-610.
component_audit.actual_observation: An isolated round-ended dark cylinder near x485,y520 and a simple diagonal support are visible, with substantial empty space around them.
component_audit.correction: Match the large housing silhouettes and integrate their piston rods, pipes and mounts into the footplate and wheel assembly; remove the isolated primitive appearance.

component_audit.target_observation: The front wheel area is partly concealed by the beam, apron and machinery; dark rims and supports sit convincingly on the rails. Concealed axle details cannot be judged.
component_audit.actual_observation: A small bright red spoked wheel near x480,y600 is exposed beneath the cylinder, with a simple horizontal axle-like member and sparse surrounding support.
component_audit.correction: Match the visible front wheel position, dark rim and occlusion, and establish convincing rail contact and connected supports without inventing hidden detail.

component_audit.target_observation: Large dark driving wheels recede under the boiler, with fine spokes, warm rim highlights and curved red splashers partially covering their tops.
component_audit.actual_observation: Successive red spoked disks are conspicuously exposed. Their rims and hubs are coarse, the surrounding gaps are large, and the target's curved splasher silhouettes are absent.
component_audit.correction: Fit the visible wheels individually in perspective, darken their mass, refine spokes and hubs, and add the target-shaped splashers and machinery occlusion.

component_audit.target_observation: Layered rods, joints, springs and dark mechanisms create dense connected construction between the cylinder area and rear driving wheels.
component_audit.actual_observation: A long simple dark bar and a few bright rod ends cross red wheels; large gaps reveal the track. The layered suspension and mechanical connections are not readable.
component_audit.correction: Build the visible rod paths and joints as connected assemblies, with suspension and intervening dark forms that reproduce the target's density and negative spaces.

component_audit.target_observation: A long oxblood barrel extends from the blackened front toward the cab, with subtle profile changes, bands, seams and broken warm reflections.
component_audit.actual_observation: The barrel is recognizable but reads as a smooth bright red cylinder with repetitive bands, a broad silver upper highlight and simplified taper and rear transition.
component_audit.correction: Match the barrel profile and longitudinal proportions, then reproduce dark oxblood paint, narrow broken highlights, band thickness, seams and localized soot.

component_audit.target_observation: A broad brass-topped fitting near x550,y205, fine handrails, valves and multiple small pipes follow the boiler and connect into the lower mechanism.
component_audit.actual_observation: Two tall narrow gold posts and long straight rails dominate. Pipe supports and valve connections are sparse and do not follow the target's silhouettes.
component_audit.correction: Match the broad dome and smaller fittings by silhouette and position; reproduce the curved pipe routes, restrained brass wear and visible mounting points.

component_audit.target_observation: The cab has a curved roof, a framed arched side window, a narrow vertical door/pillar structure, dark interior and steps linking it to the running board.
component_audit.actual_observation: The cab near x650-710 reads as a rectangular red slab with pale broad highlights and a flat roof lip. Its window opening and interior depth are not convincingly resolved.
component_audit.correction: Rebuild the cab's roof and opening silhouette, frame the target-shaped window and door, and restore dark interior depth and attached steps.

component_audit.target_observation: Behind the cab is a substantial dark red tender side with a curved upper silhouette, thin gold lining and a small emblem; its lower wheels and transition are partly visible. The coal surface is not clearly exposed.
component_audit.actual_observation: A dark box-like transition behind the cab is visible but blends into the coaches, without the target's distinct side panel, fine lining or readable emblem and lower connections.
component_audit.correction: Separate the tender silhouette from the cab and first coach, match its visible upper contour and panel trim, and resolve the exposed wheel and coupling transitions.

component_audit.target_observation: The first coach behind the tender has a rounded dark roof, aligned warm windows, narrow doors, finely divided red side panels and a dark undercarriage.
component_audit.actual_observation: A recognizable windowed coach starts farther left in the image, but its roof is slab-like, panels are coarse and its upper side carries an excessively bright cold reflection.
component_audit.correction: Match the first coach's screen-space start, roof curvature, window rhythm and door divisions; reduce the cold highlight and restore fine trim and undercarriage depth.

component_audit.target_observation: Successive coaches taper toward x920 with identifiable window rhythms, roof breaks and dark connecting intervals, losing contrast gradually.
component_audit.actual_observation: The repeated window strip recedes only to roughly x855, with weak separation between vehicles and fairly uniform dark panel treatment.
component_audit.correction: Match the number of visibly separated coach segments and their perspective spacing, including roof and coupling breaks, then graduate contrast with distance.

component_audit.target_observation: The final visible train extent approaches x920,y410 and merges into cool layered station depth beneath and beyond the terminal glazing.
component_audit.actual_observation: The train stops nearer x855,y438, to the left and lower than the target endpoint, against a largely blank gray opening.
component_audit.correction: Fit the endpoint and coach recession to the target convergence and place visible layered station forms beyond it instead of a blank backdrop.

component_audit.target_observation: At the left behind the locomotive, a broad walkable platform strip and worn pale coping remain visible, with a substantial dark riser above the track.
component_audit.actual_observation: Only a narrow dark ledge is readable behind the front assembly. The target's exposed platform width, worn coping and clear vertical separation are not reproduced.
component_audit.correction: Restore the visible left-side platform cross-section and screen-space strip, using the target's coping thickness, worn edge and darker riser.

component_audit.target_observation: Multiple lower arched bays at the left contain recessed green doors/windows, fine muntins and amber interior illumination beneath a strong storey division.
component_audit.actual_observation: Round 04 now has a separate lower level and a lamp-lit bay, unlike round 03's tall undivided opening. However, its small square-ended frame appears backed by brick and lacks the target's arched depth and glowing interior.
component_audit.correction: Construct the visible lower arched bays with correct widths, recessed reveals and real window/door openings; reproduce their amber interior depth rather than lighting a solid brick backing.

component_audit.target_observation: A distinct upper storey remains visible around and above the train: repeated arched bays, masonry infill and sill divisions occupy the left wall beneath the canopy.
component_audit.actual_observation: An upper arched opening and horizontal storey bands are newly visible. The nearest bay is disproportionately tall and broad, its grid looks brick-backed, and the repeated target bay rhythm is missing.
component_audit.correction: Fit the exposed upper-storey arch sequence, sill height and masonry infill to the target. Preserve this region in framing and evaluate it separately from the train.

component_audit.target_observation: The opposite wall contains varied soot-darkened brick, pale arch surrounds, pilasters, projecting horizontal bands and layered cornice detail.
component_audit.actual_observation: Small repetitive orange bricks and new dark horizontal strips are visible, but the broad wall remains flat and lacks the target's stone arch construction, pilaster relief and mottled soot distribution.
component_audit.correction: Match the masonry hierarchy with projecting pilasters, voussoirs, sill bands and cornices, then tune brick scale, mortar contrast and accumulated soot by region.

component_audit.target_observation: A dense dark iron fence with posts, narrow pickets, top rails and finial-like tips is plainly visible at the far left, around x0-135,y410-468.
component_audit.actual_observation: No comparable picket fence is readable in that exposed left-side region; dark ledges and the locomotive shelf do not reproduce it.
component_audit.correction: Add the target-visible fence in the correct plane, height and length, keeping its posts, top rails and fine vertical density readable behind the locomotive.

component_audit.target_observation: Small ornamental lamps, brackets and wall notices punctuate the lower bays; their warm light is subordinate to the architecture and window glow.
component_audit.actual_observation: A bright wall lamp and localized amber brick wash are visible near the left column. The bracket is simplified and the target's distributed small fixtures and notices are not reproduced.
component_audit.correction: Match fixture locations and ornamental silhouettes across the visible bays, with controlled local glow and the small wall details shown in the target.

component_audit.target_observation: A prominent branching column near x255 has a pale layered capital and multiple deep teal roof-support branches; smaller supports repeat into the left background.
component_audit.actual_observation: Round 04 adds a prominent green column near x160 and diagonal branches, a real improvement over the prior exposed wall. Its capital is dark and bulbous, its position is too far left, and the fan of supports is too sparse.
component_audit.correction: Match the column's screen position, shaft proportions, pale capital profile and multi-member branching junctions, then repeat the visible background supports at the correct perspective spacing.

component_audit.target_observation: A broad high canopy spans the station with substantial side volumes and an irregularly overlapping central glazed roof, converging above the distant train.
component_audit.actual_observation: The roof remains a narrow, highly regular ribbed tunnel. New bracing adds density, but the clear central strip and dark side sheets still dominate as simple continuous surfaces.
component_audit.correction: Match the canopy cross-section, span and convergence before detail work; reproduce the wider layered relationship between the central glazing and side roofs.

component_audit.target_observation: Deep curved paired chords, dense triangulated webs and substantial junctions overlap across the upper frame.
component_audit.actual_observation: Round 04 visibly adds triangular and diagonal members, especially toward the roof sides. Most remain thin repeated lines without the target's deep chords, consistent nodes or substantial connection plates.
component_audit.correction: Retain the useful triangulation direction but rebuild the visible trusses with target-matched depth, paired chords, coherent web joints and plates rather than increasing thin-line count.

component_audit.target_observation: Longitudinal beams, purlins and diagonal braces cross at different depths, producing irregular but connected structural overlap.
component_audit.actual_observation: Additional crisscross members improve density, but many converge into a fine repetitive mesh; local lines appear to cross without convincing physical junctions.
component_audit.correction: Organize secondary members by structural plane and depth, with actual junctions and varied projected spacing matching the reference.

component_audit.target_observation: Cool luminous roof panes vary in brightness and translucency, with thin frames, dirt and sky visibility broken by layered roof structure.
component_audit.actual_observation: Large flat gray panes form a uniform bright strip. Their regular grid and nearly constant tone lack the target's cool transmitted light, dirt variation and layered transparency.
component_audit.correction: Match pane proportions and framing, introduce restrained grime and transmitted sky variation, and preserve visibility through the glazing rather than a uniform gray fill.

component_audit.target_observation: Warm-dark side roof panels have readable seams and soot, interleaved with beams and softly lit by the station atmosphere.
component_audit.actual_observation: The sides are glossy near-black continuous sheets with repetitive seams and stark silvery streaks; new members do not resolve the material mismatch.
component_audit.correction: Reduce specular streaking and repetition, match panel scale and warm soot-darkened response, and integrate the sheets with the branching supports.

component_audit.target_observation: An arched upper glazed opening around x785-925,y270-342 contains orderly fine mullions and a strong lower crossbeam, with cool architecture visible beyond.
component_audit.actual_observation: Upper arched glazing and a lower crossbeam are now distinct, but the opening is wider/lower, its grid contains uneven overlapping lines, and it remains opaque flat gray.
component_audit.correction: Fit the arch bounds and crossbeam height, replace the irregular line grid with coherent mullions, and make the target's cool background structure visible through it.

component_audit.target_observation: Below the glazing, the station visibly continues through columns, cross-bracing, distant buildings and open space near the train endpoint.
component_audit.actual_observation: Round 04 replaces the previous full-height grid with a rectangular lower opening and a visible right post. This is a real structural improvement, but the opening contains featureless gray rather than receding scenery.
component_audit.correction: Retain the upper/lower separation while building the visible layered columns, braces and distant architecture beneath and beyond it.

component_audit.target_observation: The train, platform, lamps and structural layers recede toward approximately x935,y410 through progressively cooler, lower-contrast atmosphere.
component_audit.actual_observation: Convergence is nearer x875,y440. The train terminates abruptly against gray and a bright pale floor strip; added roof density does not create the target's layered spatial continuation.
component_audit.correction: Match convergence and train extent together, then introduce successive visible architectural layers and graded cool haze rather than a uniform background.

component_audit.target_observation: Broad irregularly sized stone slabs have softened chipped edges, uneven joints, varied tones and embedded dirt across the near platform.
component_audit.actual_observation: Regular rectangular paving repeats conspicuously, with sharp pale joints and a uniform granular sheen. The mid-distance slabs become a bright repeated grid.
component_audit.correction: Match the target slab scale and mixed layout, soften and vary the joints, add localized edge damage and integrate dirt without uniformly roughening every slab.

component_audit.target_observation: Dark shallow pools and uneven damp transitions create broken amber reflections, including a recognizable dark pool around x920,y690.
component_audit.actual_observation: Broad smooth gray and cream highlights cover the paving, with a newly bright white distant strip. There is no corresponding irregular dark pool or continuous broken amber reflection path.
component_audit.correction: Build the visible pool shapes and wet/dry transitions first, then align their broken warm reflections with the windows and lamps; avoid treating all slabs as equally glossy.

component_audit.target_observation: The edge is a narrow weathered gray-brown coping with pale chips; a subdued ochre line lies inside the platform rather than replacing the entire coping.
component_audit.actual_observation: A clean cream-yellow strip forms one of the brightest uninterrupted diagonals in the image, with crisp block divisions and little wear.
component_audit.correction: Separate coping from the interior ochre line, match their widths and positions, and darken and weather the coping until it no longer dominates the image.

component_audit.target_observation: Steel rails have narrow polished tops, rust-brown sides, visible profiles and irregularly dirty fastenings embedded in the track bed.
component_audit.actual_observation: Two strongly outlined black rails and thin highlights are present, but their cross-sections read as simple bars and their surroundings are unusually clean and exposed.
component_audit.correction: Match rail profiles and spacing, refine the narrow polished tops and rusted webs, and integrate fastenings into the surrounding dirt and ballast.

component_audit.target_observation: Dark weathered sleepers are partly buried in ballast, with variable exposure, worn grain and subdued hardware.
component_audit.actual_observation: Repeated orange-brown ties are fully exposed at regular intervals, with clean edges and small repeated fastening marks.
component_audit.correction: Darken and age the wood, vary exposed portions and burial, and match the worn fasteners and ground contact instead of evenly displaying every tie.

component_audit.target_observation: Dense irregular dark stones, coal grit and debris fill the foreground and blend into rails and sleepers.
component_audit.actual_observation: High-contrast pale gray stones are sparsely distributed around clean ties, with abrupt dark gaps and little fine dirt tying the bed together.
component_audit.correction: Match the darker stone-size distribution and density, add fine grit between larger stones, and bury tie edges and fasteners believably.

component_audit.target_observation: Thick brick piers, repeated arched bays, recessed reveals and projecting worn stone sills provide substantial depth along the right wall.
component_audit.actual_observation: The wall has recognizable brick and green window grids, but the piers and arch articulation are weaker, the wall reads flatter, and bright vertical columns interrupt the intended masonry rhythm.
component_audit.correction: Fit the pier widths and arched bay spacing, deepen reveals and restore projecting sill and stonework profiles with target-scaled brick and mortar.

component_audit.target_observation: Large green-framed panes transmit broad amber interior light and layered interior silhouettes while retaining subtle station reflections.
component_audit.actual_observation: Thick green bars sit over visible brick or dark backing in the nearest openings. Transmitted amber interior depth is absent despite bright surrounding frame highlights.
component_audit.correction: Remove the visible solid backing from the target-transparent regions, create recessed warm interiors, and tune glass and fine frame profiles to combine transmission with restrained reflection.

component_audit.target_observation: Warm tapered lanterns on ornamental brackets repeat down the wall, including large readable foreground/interior lanterns with soft local light.
component_audit.actual_observation: Small bright rectangular lamps repeat into the distance, but the nearest large warm lanterns and their ornamental mounting silhouettes are not reproduced at the target locations.
component_audit.correction: Match the housing shapes, perspective spacing and bracket profiles, then restore the missing near-window lantern presence and controlled amber cast/reflected light.

component_audit.target_observation: Near (1090,160), an aged tan enamel disk has a bold black 9 and closely stacked 3/4 with a short fraction rule, crisp printed edges, small fasteners and a restrained dark rim.
component_audit.actual_observation: The bold 9, fraction proportions and aged face artwork now visibly resemble the target far more closely than round 03's thin 9. The rendered disk is roughly 10% larger, slightly lower/right, browner and softer, with a thicker, more conspicuously chipped rim.
component_audit.correction: Preserve the now-correct artwork direction, but fit the disk outline, projection and center to the target; match face sharpness and tan value, and refine the rim thickness and fasteners. Texture provenance alone is not acceptance.

component_audit.target_observation: Fine black wrought-iron scrolls fill a triangular bracket above and right of the sign, with a large curled outer motif, small lower scrolls, wall plate and delicate hanging hardware.
component_audit.actual_observation: A thick straight horizontal bar, a dominant diagonal strut and a few simple loops attach to a large vertical green member. The target's ornamental silhouette and wall mounting are not reproduced.
component_audit.correction: Match the bracket in screen space independently of the face: trace the principal curls, lower scrolls, wall plate, hanging ring and thin section sizes, removing the oversized simple diagonal frame.

component_audit.target_observation: The near bench around x1070-1185,y465-610 has fine dark wood slats, a sloped back, curved ornamental arms and legs, with a readable seat.
component_audit.actual_observation: Brown slats are visible, but the back and arms sit higher, the dark green arms are angular, and upright cases obscure much of the seat and lower structure.
component_audit.correction: Fit the bench silhouette and seat height, refine curved arms and leg construction, and reposition neighboring cases to recover the target's visible slat and seat area.

component_audit.target_observation: A compact curved dark metal handle rises behind the cage, with a rounded worn tray, slim supports and a substantial visible spoked wheel near the bottom right.
component_audit.actual_observation: An oversized angular gold-brown frame spans across the top of the foreground group and off the right edge. The tray looks like a thick wooden slab and its wheels are largely cropped or hidden.
component_audit.correction: Rebuild the target's curved handle and compact frame, fit the rounded metal tray inside the image, and expose the correct wheel, axle and worn structural connections.

component_audit.target_observation: The main foreground trunk has rounded dark leather thickness, piping, straps, small brass corners and a readable front lock; its complete front largely fits inside the frame.
component_audit.actual_observation: A very large orange-brown rectangular case is cropped at the bottom and right. Flat faces, sharp corners and oversized square brass plates dominate; the target front lock arrangement is not readable.
component_audit.correction: Correct scale and framing before detail, then reproduce the rounded leather edges, seams, straps, shaped lock and small corner hardware with varied wear.

component_audit.target_observation: Several differently sized worn cases sit beside the bench and farther down the wall, with distinct dark leather colors, handles and grounded stacking.
component_audit.actual_observation: Bright reddish rectangular cases cluster farther left into the aisle near x965-1125; a small box sits on the foreground trunk. Most share the same sharp corners, square brass patches and simple handle treatment.
component_audit.correction: Match each visible case's location, silhouette and support, differentiate leather tones and edge construction, and reproduce the target's small handles and fittings.

component_audit.target_observation: The delicate brass cage occupies roughly x1245-1395,y445-615, with thin closely spaced bars, a fine dome and rings, a small finial and visible interior contents.
component_audit.actual_observation: The cage is larger and farther left, extending approximately x1200-1410,y445-680. Thick orange bars, heavy rings and a deep base dominate; no comparable interior contents are legible.
component_audit.correction: Reduce width and height, move the body right and raise its base to the target support level; refine the bars, dome, rings, finial and base, and reproduce the visible contents.

component_audit.target_observation: Thick folded burgundy fabric sits across the trunk around x1300-1515,y590-725, with rounded layered folds and a long soft fringed drape.
component_audit.actual_observation: Angular reddish strips appear above the right-hand cases and run into the frame edge. They do not form the target's folded volume or hanging fringe.
component_audit.correction: Fit the complete fabric silhouette inside the frame, form rounded stacked folds and a gravity-led drape, and add fine fringe with a soft woven response.

component_audit.target_observation: An analog clock hangs near x950,y350; posters/notices, small cases and additional benches dress the right wall at varied depths.
component_audit.actual_observation: A small repeated 9 sign occupies the clock region. Receding benches and cases exist, but the target's analog clock face and prominent wall notices are absent or unreadable.
component_audit.correction: Replace the repeated numeral sign with the target-style clock at the correct location, add the visible notices, and match the sizes and spacing of the smaller station props.

component_audit.target_observation: Important dark machinery remains readable while roof light, warm windows and wet reflections are controlled; no broad pale surface overwhelms the frame.
component_audit.actual_observation: The smokebox and chimney have broad silver highlights, the platform edge is very bright, and round 04 adds a large near-white distant floor region while leaving window interiors and mechanical gaps dark.
component_audit.correction: Rebalance local material and light response to preserve dark form without broad silver or white patches; do not solve the problem by uniformly lowering exposure.

component_audit.target_observation: Cool blue-gray roof and distant air contrast with warm brick, dark oxblood paint, amber windows and reflected gold on wet paving.
component_audit.actual_observation: Warm brick and some amber pools are present, including a new opposite-wall lamp wash, but gray-white roof/floor light and orange foreground props dominate instead of the target's balanced cool-warm depth.
component_audit.correction: Coordinate cool transmitted skylight and atmospheric distance with broad amber window light and restrained local lamp warmth, then retune red paint and brass under that setup.

component_audit.target_observation: Broken warm reflections follow the damp platform; the boiler and leather carry narrow curved highlights, and windows combine transmitted light with subtle reflected structure.
component_audit.actual_observation: The floor has broad pale blocks and a cold distant strip, the smokebox has a large silver patch, coach tops have a bright cold band, and the windows do not show comparable layered reflection/transmission.
component_audit.correction: Match reflection shape, color and roughness separately on stone, steel, paint, leather and glass, with the target light sources and visible wet regions driving their placement.

component_audit.target_observation: A broad irregular translucent plume billows above the stack and drifts into the upper roof, catching soft gray skylight.
component_audit.actual_observation: Two narrow bright nearly vertical streaks extend from the stack toward the top edge, with little lateral spread or billowing volume.
component_audit.correction: Match the plume's broad envelope, irregular density, drift and translucency, preserving a coherent origin at the stack and softer illumination.

component_audit.target_observation: Low diffuse steam rolls around the front cylinder and driving gear, spreading toward the rails and partially obscuring machinery.
component_audit.actual_observation: Several small pale wisps appear over the exposed red wheels, but they are separated and elevated, leaving the target's low rolling envelope absent.
component_audit.correction: Place broader low-emission volumes around the target-visible cylinder and gear locations, with irregular overlapping density and interaction with the rail-level forms.

component_audit.target_observation: Layered cool haze separates trusses, coaches and terminal architecture while retaining silhouettes and a visible continuation beyond the train.
component_audit.actual_observation: Foreground and roof members remain comparatively hard; the terminal background is flat gray and the brighter distant floor does not supply atmospheric layers.
component_audit.correction: First provide the missing distant geometry, then tune haze to reduce contrast progressively and scatter cool light without erasing the terminal's layered forms.

component_audit.target_observation: Fine structural and prop silhouettes remain coherent; the full left buffer and principal foreground trunk, cloth and trolley elements are intentionally readable.
component_audit.actual_observation: The left buffer, trunk, trolley and cloth are cropped incorrectly. Thin roof lines and coarse cage bars produce harsh repetitive detail; bright joints repeat across paving, and large dark planar shapes beneath the front read as simplified geometry.
component_audit.correction: Correct framing and connected geometry first, reduce repetitive thin-line clutter and surface noise, and inspect native-resolution edges and intersections after the major reconstruction.

assessment: A small genuine improvement to 5.0/10, not a substantial full-scene breakthrough. Compared with the actual round 03 pixels, round 04 visibly introduces a two-level opposing facade, a branching column, more roof triangulation and a separate lower terminal opening. The sign's bold 9 and stacked fraction are also substantially closer to the target. Those observable changes justify limited composition and detail gains, independently of any claimed architectural work. However, the opposing facade still has the wrong bay proportions, brick-backed openings, weak masonry hierarchy and no target-visible fence. The terminal opening is empty gray rather than a continuation of the station. Locomotive construction and oversized foreground props are essentially unchanged, while a brighter cold floor and coach highlights do not reproduce the target lighting. All 58 components were inspected; the newly improved sign face does not cancel missing background architecture or other major regions.

composition.credit: The previously undivided opposing wall now has a readable storey split and freestanding branching support; the terminal has distinct upper glazing and a lower opening; added roof webs improve structural layering.
gaps: These remain schematic approximations: opposing bay rhythm, column position, facade depth and terminal continuation are incorrect.
Locomotive front framing, raised apron, cylinder mass, cab shape and complete buffer silhouettes are unresolved.
The train ends too far left and low, and the canopy still reads as a narrow repeated tunnel.
Cage, trolley, trunk and blanket retain major scale, placement and cropping errors.

lighting.credit: New opposite-wall amber illumination and brighter receding illumination make some forms more legible.
gaps: The receding floor is now excessively cold and pale; this is not the target's broken amber reflection path.
Window interiors remain dark or brick-backed, removing the target's largest warm transmitted-light regions.
Broad silver smokebox/chimney highlights, the cream coping and cold coach highlights remain inappropriate.
The target's volumetric chimney plume, low rolling steam and layered cool distance are absent.

materials.credit: The sign face has improved local aging and color structure, but its source image is not evidence of scene-wide material fidelity.
gaps: No substantial visible improvement to wet stone, dark oxblood paint, blackened steel, leather thickness, fine aged brass or soft fabric.
The platform has uniform sheen and repeated sharp joints rather than irregular dark pools and damp transitions.
Roof sheets and foreground cases retain broad synthetic-looking highlights and simplified surface construction.
Both facades lack convincing recessed illuminated glass; track materials remain cleanly separated and repetitive.

details.credit: The bold sign typography and aged artwork now visibly track the target, and the added storey bands, branching support and roof webs supply real previously missing detail.
gaps: The sign bracket, rim, projected size and rendered sharpness still differ.
Opposing railings, arched reveals, masonry articulation and background architectural layers remain missing or wrong.
Train fittings and connected running gear, fine cage construction, luggage hardware, fabric fringe and analog clock remain unresolved.
More thin roof lines are not equivalent to correctly connected deep trusses.

visible_improvements: The opposing station now has a distinct upper/lower storey division, rather than round 03's single tall undivided opening.
A freestanding branching column and local warm wall lamp are now visible behind the locomotive.
Additional roof triangulation creates more structural density and overlap than round 03.
The terminal grid no longer continues uninterrupted to platform level: upper glazing, a crossbeam and a lower opening are distinct.
The sign now has the target-like bold 9, closely stacked fraction and aged printed face instead of the prior thin 9 on pale enamel.

regressions.evidence: Relative to round 03, round 04 introduces a broad much brighter white/cool reflective floor region leading into the terminal opening.
regressions.consequence: The target's darker stone and narrow broken amber reflection pattern are displaced by a conspicuous pale strip. Greater brightness alone is not improved lighting fidelity.

regressions.evidence: The receding coach roof-edge and upper-side band is much brighter and colder in round 04 than in round 03.
regressions.consequence: It competes with the station lighting and flattens the coach construction instead of reproducing the target's restrained warm window and roof-edge reflections.

architectural_change_outcome.basis: These outcomes refer to visible differences between the supplied round images, not implementation history.
architectural_change_outcome.opposing_facade: Partially effective and visibly changed. Adding two levels and a column is directionally correct, but the exposed backdrop remains materially and architecturally unlike the target. It is not complete merely because the train hides part of it.
architectural_change_outcome.roof_structure: Partially effective. More triangulation is visible, but deep coherent trusses and correct canopy proportions are still missing.
architectural_change_outcome.terminal_restructure: Partially effective. The upper/lower separation is meaningful; the newly exposed lower opening contains no comparable receding station scenery.
architectural_change_outcome.sign_artwork: Clearly effective locally. The actual bold numeral artwork is much closer. Placement, disk scale, rim, rendered color/sharpness and ornamental bracket still require independent correction.
architectural_change_outcome.lighting: Mixed. Added architectural illumination improves legibility, but the cold white floor and coach highlight introduce mismatches. No lighting score increase is warranted.
architectural_change_outcome.train_and_foreground: No meaningful structural improvement is visible in the locomotive, oversized luggage group, cage, trolley or cloth relative to round 03.

prioritized_fixes.title: Reconstruct the exposed opposing station, not just its storey split
prioritized_fixes.action: Fit the lower and upper arched bay rhythm, recessed illuminated openings, stone surrounds, pilasters, projecting bands, left platform and picket fence. Move and reshape the prominent branching column to the target silhouette. Audit all exposed portions around the train.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: At full frame and in a left-side crop, the target's two-storey architecture, warm recessed lower bays, upper infill, worn coping and dense fence are all independently recognizable at matching positions. No target-transparent opening is visibly filled with brick.

prioritized_fixes.title: Replace the locomotive's schematic front and complete its front-to-back construction
prioritized_fixes.action: Fit both complete buffers, beam and chimney landmarks, then rebuild the raised apron, connected coupling, cylinder housings and layered running gear. Correct cab openings, tender identity and coach recession without solving one landmark by moving the entire camera.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: Both buffers clear the frame; the beam and stack align together; the apron is a shaped structural face rather than a shelf; visible mechanisms connect; the cab has depth; the train ends near the target endpoint.

prioritized_fixes.title: Solve transmitted window light and wet-platform reflections together
prioritized_fixes.action: Create visible amber interior depth in both facades; replace uniform paving sheen with target-shaped dark pools and wet/dry transitions; separate and weather the coping and ochre line. Control silver locomotive highlights and the new white floor/coach bands under the same lighting setup.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: The floor has the target's broken amber path and dark irregular pools, the cream edge no longer dominates, windows visibly transmit warm interior light, and steel and coach reflections no longer form broad silver-white patches.

prioritized_fixes.title: Turn added roof lines and the terminal opening into coherent spatial architecture
prioritized_fixes.action: Fit canopy span and convergence, give primary trusses physical depth and coherent joints, organize secondary planes, and build the visible station layers beyond the upper and lower terminal openings. Apply cool haze only after that geometry is readable.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: Deep connected trusses replace the repeated thin-line tunnel; the upper arch and crossbeam match their target bounds; columns and distant architecture continue below and beyond the glazing instead of ending in featureless gray.

prioritized_fixes.title: Refit the foreground grouping before adding surface detail
prioritized_fixes.action: Reduce and move the cage right, raise its base, fit the rounded trunk and trolley inside the frame, restore the compact curved handle and visible wheel, and replace angular cloth strips with folded burgundy fabric and fringe. Reposition cases to expose the target bench.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: The cage approximates the target's x1245-1395,y445-615 envelope; the trunk front, trolley wheel and folded cloth are readable inside the frame; leather is rounded, cage bars are fine and the bench has curved arms.

prioritized_fixes.title: Match the complete sign, not just its source artwork
prioritized_fixes.action: Keep the improved bold numeral face but correct projected diameter, center, tilt, tan value, sharpness, rim and fasteners. Rebuild the separate ornamental bracket with target-matched curls, hanging hardware and wall mounting.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: A same-scale sign crop aligns the disk outline and numeral placement without an oversized thick rim; its face retains target-like contrast and aging; the bracket shows the large outer curl and smaller scrolls rather than a thick diagonal brace.

prioritized_fixes.title: Resolve remaining target-specific dressing, track and steam
prioritized_fixes.action: Match right-wall piers and lanterns, replace the repeated small 9 with the analog clock, add visible notices, weather and bury sleepers in dark ballast, and replace narrow chimney streaks and isolated wheel wisps with target-shaped steam volumes.
prioritized_fixes.acceptance: The clock and wall dressing match their reference roles and locations; rails and ties sit within a continuous dirty track bed; broad drifting chimney steam and low rolling wheel steam reproduce the target envelopes without hiding unresolved geometry.

repeated_gaps.gap: Locomotive framing and connected mechanical construction
repeated_gaps.evidence: The clipped buffer, high beam/stack, shallow apron, repeated hanging hoses, sparse running gear and slab-like cab remain visible.

repeated_gaps.gap: Warm wet stone, illuminated interiors and cool atmospheric depth
repeated_gaps.evidence: The dark pools and amber reflection path are absent, windows still lack interior depth, and the brighter floor ends at featureless gray.

repeated_gaps.gap: Foreground prop scale, framing and tactile construction
repeated_gaps.evidence: The cage is too large and low, the trunk/trolley are cropped, and angular cloth, thick bars and square hardware remain.
Added webs and a lower opening are visible improvements, but coherent deep trusses and actual receding architecture are still absent.

The previous written verdict did not explicitly cover this region. Round 04 adds two levels and a column, but incorrect arches, brick-backed openings, flat masonry, insufficient platform exposure and missing railings remain. No earlier audit coverage is retroactively claimed.
The bold 9 and fraction now visibly improve on round 03. The incorrect bracket remains, with smaller residual face-size, rim and rendered-tone errors.

stall_assessment.two_round_score_basis: The supplied round 03 verdict records round 02 at 4.7. This round is 5.0, a gain of 0.3 over that recorded baseline. Round 02 pixels were not independently inspected.
stall_assessment.reason: The strict same-or-worse-after-rethink STALLED condition is not met: the visible facade split, branching support, roof webs, terminal separation and corrected bold sign artwork justify a net increase from 4.8 to 5.0. This is not a discretionary increment to avoid stalling; composition gains 0.1 for actual structural layout changes and details gains 0.1 for actual artwork/construction changes, while lighting and materials receive no gain. The changes are insufficient as a whole-scene solution. Repeated major gaps and only 0.3 gain over the recorded two-round baseline keep the process in stall-approaching territory and require a substantial rethink rather than small decorative tweaks. If that subsequent rethink produces the same score or worse, report STALLED and require user input.
stall_assessment.required_next_approach: Reassess whether the core locomotive, architecture and foreground assets can supply the target silhouettes and material construction at all. Reconstruct the deficient connected assemblies and scene depth as coordinated screen-space matches; do not respond with only more thin roof lines, local brightness changes or additional isolated detail.
completion_blockers: Visual similarity is 5.0/10, below the 8/10 goal.
